purpose: Backward walk and two target-facing sidesteps for the Graybox Reach light enemy.

actions.walk_backward: 20 unique frames + loop endpoint; 15 Hz, 1.33s cycle
actions.strafe_left: 16 unique frames + loop endpoint; 15 Hz, 1.07s cycle
actions.strafe_right: 16 unique frames + loop endpoint; 15 Hz, 1.07s cycle

poses: Narrow collected stance and double support at entry for the sidesteps; 6000-unit half-stance and forward-facing knees.
Leading foot reaches outward while the trailing foot supports; trailing foot follows without crossing.
Torso remains aimed toward the target, retaining v5 torso twist and separate cannon/claw inertia.
Retreat uses low backward steps, with soft knees and a forward-looking head.
editing: Each .blend contains the 22-bone rig, original mesh weights, packed texture and one looping action. Save manual edits before regeneration. Regeneration replaces these snapshots. Export then copy the PSXA into assets/animations/light_directional_v1.
calibration: The light enemy walk speed cooks to 2 units/tick; spacing_speed_percent=25 selects 0.5 units/tick for circling and retreat. A Q8 remainder preserves sub-unit travel at 60 Hz and batched updates. Clips remain at 15 Hz with shorter strides. Source model scale113 and instance scale417 produce Q12 184; cooking divides positions by16. The distance-driven gait clock uses this fractional spacing speed as its nominal rate.
limits: Contact checks assume straight constant-speed movement. Orbit rotation, radius correction and collisions can still introduce foot slip.
cooking: The three directional clips set preserve_samples=true to retain contact timing and equal left/right cadence.
foot_orientation: Both foot chains use their bind-pose orientation, where the authored heel/toe sole vertices are coplanar and horizontal. IK solves the knees to the grounded ankle targets. The older sampled walk poses were pitched onto the toes; a minimum-height contact check alone did not detect that.
